title: Research: restore larger-domain ceiling evaluation with certified range reduction
head: 751145508c6870210fc2a0955ab7499e11a49dc4
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The frozen ceiling evaluator raises `RecursionError` on the valid call `child_cost(16,1024,1/1000)`. Fixing only its logarithm still leaves `ceiling({1:1},32768,10,1,0)` unable to evaluate its fixed upper probe. This opt-in, source-authenticated adapter uses binary logarithm reduction and outward exponential scaling/squaring to complete those evaluations. It preserves the exact original exponential output inside its declared interval and retains all ten selected/lever grid brackets and complete stdout.

The package proves the range-reduction enclosure arguments and checks them against independent rational Mercator/unscaled Taylor oracles. Larger-base examples are fully declared planning profiles, not physical constructions. No selected frontier, frozen file, supplier admission or production pin is changed.

## Task and overlap

The original P104 task (`bb9f853220a03e57e0cfc933b855eedc`) changed scope after #2640 independently supplied the proposed cut theorem; the duplicate was retired and corroboration was posted there. This contribution addresses the demonstrated planner failure instead. #2441 interval caching and #2552 integer Taylor acceleration are distinct performance changes. Existing repository binary-logarithm work supplies prior technique, not this repair.

Scientific inputs remain pinned to `b4560d9e7216f72b73c5aa940ac099c05e33ccf9`; the branch was refreshed to canonical `bd0f96670d18440cdbd88d6d0cea6b08d735cab3`, priority five. The nine live input files and guidance are unchanged. Cached overlap covers 833 open PRs at 16:47:56 UTC and 1,239 Discussion records at 15:22:22 UTC; targeted REST search supplemented the stale Discussion snapshot after GraphQL quota exhaustion. Coverage and open obligations are in TASK.json.

## Validation

`python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ceiling-range-reduction` passes: 141 logarithm cases, seven independent exponential intervals, eleven exact rational powers, two reproduced original failures, ten retained brackets/stdout and two strict planning brackets. Four Git-free public-CLI tests pass, including read-only replay, three source corruptions, changed/Boolean/float receipt corruptions, overwrite refusal and two actual arithmetic mutations. All eight staged files match the tested working bytes. Two independent agent proof/API reviews found no remaining issue after the receipt-type fix. Hosted CI and selected cold multiplication replay are not claimed.

## Credit and open next questions

Retains Douglas Colkitt and the original Claude-assisted engine's model, bounds and fixture credit. The adjacent exponential restriction was identified by another Codex agent and included in this same repair. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The next question is an explicit consumer-by-consumer source-pin migration; this adapter deliberately does not perform it.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
